prompt: Use case: game character turnaround / walking pose sprite sheet. Use supplied approved Fenris idle strip as CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PIXEL-ART STYLE REFERENCE. Make ONE review sheet with FIVE unique WALKING DIRECTION KEY POSES, a single mid-stride frame per direction, NOT animation sequences. Layout is a strict 3 column x 2 row grid with equal cells. TOP LEFT: LEFT — walking toward screen left in a clear side profile, head and body aligned left. TOP CENTER: UP-LEFT — walking diagonally away from viewer toward upper left, predominantly rear three-quarter view with a slight left side view and just an edge of muzzle, show back of shoulders rather than chest. TOP RIGHT: UP — walking directly away from viewer, true BACK VIEW, both ears from behind, broad back with grey-white fur, rear of brown shorts, tail attached naturally at rear waistband, no eyes or chest visible. BOTTOM LEFT: DOWN-LEFT — walking diagonally toward viewer and screen left, front three-quarter view, chest and left-facing muzzle visible. BOTTOM CENTER: DOWN — walking directly toward viewer, full front view, balanced frontal muzzle with two cyan eyes, broad chest and abdomen. BOTTOM RIGHT: completely EMPTY transparent cell. Exactly these five sprites, each full body, centered within its cell. EVERY pose is a calm natural walking mid-stride: one foot forward and opposite arm forward, gentle stride, not standing wide in idle stance, not running, no exaggerated action. Consistent apparent character size, shared foot baseline in each cell, same body proportions across directions, enough transparent padding so no ears, tails, hands or feet cross cell borders. Fenris identity must remain EXACT: adult upright muscular anthropomorphic white wolf with neutral grey fur accents, reasonably broad waist, modest triangular ears, long wolf muzzle, cyan eyes only within actual eyes, plain clean closed muzzle/mouth with NO lipstick or stray blue brow marks, large clawed hands and digitigrade wolf legs, simple brown ragged knee-above shorts, compact bushy white-grey tail. White-grey fur remains visible on belly, not clothing. No added belts, armor, shoes, weapons, hats, extra accessories. Preserve the crisp high-detail pixel-art rendering and black outlines of reference; avoid smooth illustration, chibi, realism, enlarged head, skinny body. Same neutral lighting and coherent fur pattern in all views. Transparent background with actual alpha, no floor, no shadows, no labels/text, no gridlines. Requested output 1536x1368, each of six cells512x684. User will review these direction designs before a walking cycle is made.
postprocessing: Five generated poses cropped to equal transparent canvases; three opposites mirrored horizontally; labeled compass preview composed for review.
